race.description: Ladbrokes Cranbourne Cup Saturday 21 Nov Hcp (Bm62)
race.comment: ARADEO (9) resumed with a good run at Geelong when well in the market, running on nicely but just missing in an encouraging return. She's lightly raced and yet to miss a place in five starts, expect she improves off that and can go one better. ILLUMINANCE (6) has only won 2 from 26 but is very consistent. Just fair latest but she'd been typically honest prior and she does go well here (7 seconds from 11 starts!) MASTER OF THE AIR (1) looks ready to win third up after chasing a nice one at Seymour. Back in trip is interesting but the stable certainly know what they're doing. JENNI POPPINS (10) resumes having gone to the paddock a maiden winner. She can run well fresh. SMALL TOWN HERO (3) draws wide but can roll forward and figure.
